entries.title: What AI Is Made Of
entries.author: Sid Mofya
entries.format: Interactive 3D model with a list view and a published research trail
entries.question: What must exist before a gigawatt of AI computation can operate?
entries.description: An interactive reference model of a hypothetical one-gigawatt AI data centre: power and cooling systems, equipment and the assumptions behind the material estimates.
interpretation: An infrastructure thesis should identify which demand measure it uses and what supporting capacity it assumes.
A material-demand estimate needs explicit equipment boundaries and sensitivity checks.
Define the evidence still needed before relying on a modeled total.
application_questions: Which dependency could change your investment case?
entries.scope_note: A hypothetical plant with one gigawatt of commissioned IT electrical capacity. Run 04 material figures are estimates for partial equipment scope; low, base and high are design cases, not probabilities or confidence intervals. Not an operating facility, construction design or procurement schedule.

entries.title: From Copper to Compute
entries.author: Sid Mofya
entries.format: Five-scene illustrated journey with a source register
entries.question: Where in the copper value chain does your opportunity actually sit?
entries.description: A five-scene journey from ore to a representative component in a hypothetical AI data centre, using Zambian mining and processing examples.
interpretation: An investment thesis should specify the product, customer and capabilities it concerns.
Identify which inputs drive sensitivity instead of treating a single estimate as a forecast.
Partnerships, power, logistics, financing and customer qualification still need investigation.
application_questions: What does this mean for your position in the copper value chain?
entries.scope_note: Representative examples and a conditional quantity example. Not a procurement order, shipment timetable or verified whole-campus inventory. Throughput comparisons are not lead times. It does not trace a shipment or establish a supplier relationship.
entries.source_review_basis: The exhibit footer states: Public evidence reviewed 16 November 2026.
